facts.text: The user wants a TypeScript function to accept an arbitrary array of keys and return an array of results with the same length as the input array.
The user wants to specify the value type for each kv entry result using a generic argument.
The user cannot pass `as const` arrays to the function now.
The user asked whether the returned array is still mutable.

keyphrases: output array same length as input
type-safe mapping of keys to values
